mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN history.amount > 0 THEN history.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_earned, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN history.amount < 0 THEN -history.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_used, COALESCE(user_info.point, 0) AS balance, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN history.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') THEN history.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS monthly_change FROM USERS user_info LEFT JOIN POINT_HISTORY history ON history.user_id = user_info.id WHERE user_info.id = #{userId}

SELECT history.id, CASE history.type WHEN 'REWARD' THEN '주간 랭킹 보상' WHEN 'BOX_REWARD' THEN '랜덤박스 즉시 보상' WHEN 'INSTANT_REWARD' THEN '랜덤박스 즉시 보상' WHEN 'BOX_OPEN' THEN '랜덤박스 오픈' ELSE COALESCE(history.description, '포인트 변동') END AS title, history.description, CASE WHEN history.amount >= 0 THEN 'EARN' ELSE 'USE' END AS history_type, CASE WHEN history.type IN ('REWARD') THEN '랭킹' WHEN history.type IN ('BOX_REWARD', 'INSTANT_REWARD', 'BOX_OPEN') THEN '랜덤박스' ELSE history.type END AS category, history.amount, history.created_at, CASE WHEN history.amount >= 0 THEN '적립' ELSE '사용' END AS status FROM POINT_HISTORY history WHERE ORDER BY
history.created_at ASC, history.id ASC
history.created_at DESC, history.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
